appearance.subtle: Their skin looks slightly different from the last time you saw them.
appearance.obvious: Their skin has visibly changed texture across the exposed parts, thickened where the weather has been at it.
appearance.extreme: They are a different shape from one week to the next. Right now they are pale and thick-hided and shedding, and next week they will not be.

description: Your body has started solving problems on its own. Whatever is trying to kill you today, you are a little more resistant to it by evening.
name: Adaptive Flesh
